items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: What kind of pieces did you play with the Excelsior band... [INTERVIEWEE] We used ragtime... That's what the people would like about it... the old Mobile Excelsior band.

ctx.x: What kind of pieces did you play with the Excelsior band and the other bands you played with even before? What kind of music did you use? Any ragtime? Well, yeah, yeah.

We used ragtime, all kind of time. We mixed it up all kind of way. That's what the people would like about it, you see? And all that foolishness is take with them, you know, and they'd follow their way. And when they mix up that stuff and they'd play it good and they'd sound good, you know. And it wasn't nothing but the Excelsior band anywhere you go in Mobile, practically in the south. From St. Louis on down this way, anyone can tell you the old Mobile Excelsior band. But now it's about gone. There's a few…
Can you tell me about the blues? When was the first time you ever heard anybody sing the blues or play the blues?
